svg.text: Each Airflow deployment is BOTH producer and consumer via the embedded astro-dependency-plugin; each plugin subscribes only to the dataset topics it depends on.
Airflow Deployments (each embeds astro-dependency-plugin: produces + consumes)

g.text: Airflow deployment (owns risk datasets; depends on portfolio + reference)
filter: drop own deployment events (subscribes to N=2 topics)
Airflow deployment (owns reference datasets; consumed by others)
scales to one topic per dataset across the platform — naming convention & topic registry required
Non-Airflow consumer (e.g. web app / streaming UI)
refreshes dashboard widgets when new VaR is published
airflow: risk → subscribes to 2 topics (portfolio + reference)
As DAGs gain dependencies, each plugin must subscribe to N topics —
subscription lists, ACLs, and consumer-group rebalancing all grow with N.
N can reach hundreds across the platform.
Plugins subscribe to exactly the datasets they depend on — zero filtering noise.
Natural 1:1 alignment with Airflow Asset URIs. Per-dataset ACLs & retention.
N topics, N schema-registry entries, N ACLs — provisioning must be automated.
Each Airflow plugin manages a growing subscription list as dependencies expand.
Monitoring, alerting, and consumer-group rebalancing get harder at scale.

mxCell.value: airflow: portfolio Airflow deployment (owns portfolio datasets)
Airflow Assets (no upstream deps in this deployment for this DAG)
astro-dependency-plugin produces: data-ready.portfolio.daily_positions consumes: (none — no upstream dataset deps) filter: drop own deployment events
airflow: risk Airflow deployment (owns risk datasets; depends on portfolio + reference)
astro-dependency-plugin produces: data-ready.risk.var_calculations consumes: portfolio.daily_positions, reference.security_master filter: drop own deployment events (subscribes to N=2 topics)
airflow: reference Airflow deployment (owns reference datasets; consumed by others)
Airflow Assets (no upstream deps in this deployment for this DAG)
astro-dependency-plugin produces: data-ready.reference.security_master consumes: (none — top of dependency chain) filter: drop own deployment events
... (N more topics) — scales to one topic per dataset across the platform
Risk Dashboard service (non-Airflow consumer) subscribes: data-ready.risk.var_calculations refreshes dashboard widgets when new VaR is published

Cumulative subscription pattern (the sprawl point) airflow: portfolio → 0 topics airflow: risk → 2 topics (portfolio + reference) airflow: reference → 0 topics As DAGs gain dependencies, each plugin must subscribe to N topics — N can reach hundreds.

Tradeoff: precision vs sprawl Pro: precision — zero filtering noise; 1:1 with Asset URIs; per-dataset ACLs. Con: sprawl — N topics, N schema entries, N ACLs; growing subscription lists; harder monitoring & rebalancing.
